observations.fact: The first text/list drawing origin is window-relative this+0x18+0x0f, this+0x1c+0xeb.
Each record is obtained from the stream at this+0x968+8 through 0x00468BF0 with length argument 0x0d; a line is accepted when its second byte is LF.
Lines beginning with ';' are treated as separators/comments; lines beginning with '#' are parsed as an integer marker and compared with the requested section/id.
A selected non-marker line is parsed by 0x0045E200 into a large local record area; exact field meanings remain pending.
Rows are rendered at 15-pixel vertical increments. The stream record pointer advances by 0x104 bytes per rendered row.
The loop continues until the requested row count is reached, then resumes reading the next stream line.
